summary: Sinovac Biotech filed a Form 6-K containing a press release of unaudited financial results for the first half of 2025. The release reports sales of $130.3 million and a net loss of $21.7 million, with CEO commentary on global strategy and R&D pipeline progress. There is no transaction, special situation, or event triggering a special-situations category. This is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer.
